description: Manually reviewed template aliases for the Mendeley training workbook. Each family lists template groups (ids from finguard.data.split.cluster_templates) that are variants of the same underlying document, so they must stay in one split partition. 'opening' must match the start of the group's representative normalised template; the build fails if an id or opening no longer matches. Reviewed 2026-10-14 from the training workbook only (the official test workbook was not opened). Evidence: full normalised templates were read side by side.

families.name: loan_application

members.opening: Dear <name>, we have received your loan application at <company>
Dear <name>, your recent loan application at <company>

families.reason: Sentence-by-sentence paraphrase: same facts (review status, submission date, address/email/phone/SSN, credit card, status URL) in the same order; identical entity-slot sequence. Word similarity 0.746.

families.name: subscription_and_cfo_audit

members.opening: Dear <name>, your subscription with <company> is up for renewal
Dear <name>, your subscription with <company> is approaching its renewal date
Dear <name>, your subscription with <company> is up for renewal
During the audit of the financial statements for <company>

families.reason: t70d5a61ad1 and tf9fd01c909 are paraphrases (similarity 0.738, identical slot sequence). tba5a9c1d21 is a generator concatenation defect: it contains t70d5a61ad1 verbatim followed, with no space ('support team.During'), by a paraphrase of the CFO-audit template t41fa5c5a18 (similarity 0.571). Separating any of these would put a whole template on both sides of a split.
